provenance.description: Hand-authored synthetic current-job log specimens and explicit gold. No production log or real credential is included. No TypeSafe/Jev inference was run; probabilities are not gold labels. Some adversarial text impersonates model output and has no authority. Secret-shaped strings are inert synthetic test data.

preAcceptanceCoverageAddition.reason: Before acceptance and before any inference or tuning, append two independent safe adversarial-insufficient excerpts to satisfy the strict requirement of at least 20 adversarial examples within the insufficient/ambiguous slice. All previous 226 case records and gold labels are unchanged.

splitPolicy.description: Related original logs, blocked/safe-range siblings and identity stay in one source group and one split. Development uses distinct source diagnostic families; held-out data is not a tuning input. All labels concern only approved current-excerpt evidence.
splitPolicy.coverageFreezeNote: The 2026-10-29 pre-acceptance coverage addition appends two distinct held-out source groups. Existing group assignments and every prior case are unchanged; no model outputs informed this addition.

spanPolicy.lineNumbers: 1-based original line indices; one nonempty source line per span
spanPolicy.description: Ready spans are the deterministic approved projection for originalLines and optional selectedRange. Blocked/empty input has no cloud-approved spans. Truncated-away source text never earns support.

goldPolicy.true: The approved current-job excerpt explicitly reports the category; acceptableSpanIds selects one or more existing supporting spans.
goldPolicy.false: The approved excerpt does not report that observation; configuration, quoted examples and success do not count.
goldPolicy.null: Evidence is ambiguous, unbound, or not cloud-approved; exclude category truth denominators and count surfaced concrete observations separately as unsupported.
goldPolicy.probabilities: No expected model probabilities are encoded. Confidence is not evidence.

policyDenominators.ready: Safe input may still be semantically insufficient or ambiguous. Use classification/slices/insufficientReason for that rubric.
policyDenominators.suspected-secret: Local refusal only; no semantic negative credit, no live submission.
policyDenominators.insufficient: Zero usable spans only; no model call and no fabricated support.
